extracted.intended_audience: people attempting to create or locate a Wikipedia article (new/existing contributors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating or locating a Wikipedia page (checking for existing pages, account requirements, handling recent creations or deletions, and using the article-drafting tools).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a prerequisite for creating a page; if you are not logged in or autoconfirmed you cannot create the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard to submit a draft
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the article directly (e.g., due to account restrictions), submit a draft through the article wizard so experienced editors can review and assist with publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request a new article
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot or should not create the page yourself, follow the process for requesting a new article so others can consider creating it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Saturday Night Live 2016' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify whether the topic already exists under a different title or spelling to avoid duplicates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check what links to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can show whether the topic is mentioned elsewhere and whether a redirect or section addition is more appropriate than a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles are case sensitive (except first character) and consider redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization and create redirects as needed so users find the correct page regardless of minor title variations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newly created pages may be temporarily invisible
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a recently created page to exist but cannot see it, allow time for propagation or use purge to refresh the page cache before re-creating or requesting it.

rubrics_metrics.name: If the page was deleted, consult the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion records and the provided explanatory resources to understand deletion reasons and whether recreation is appropriate or requires different content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for alternative titles or spellings (explicit prompt)
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for 'Saturday Night Live 2016' on one of Wikipedia's sister projects or search to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use searches across Wikipedia and its sister projects (Wiktionary, Wikiquote, etc.) to locate relevant content or decide whether to create a new page.
